subject: Mathematics
title: Differential Equations
summary: Differential equation function ko uske derivatives se jodti hai. Iska order sabse oonchi derivative hai; degree us derivative ki power hai jab equation derivatives mein polynomial ho.
General solution mein order jitne arbitrary constants hote hain; particular solution initial conditions use karta hai.

JEE methods: variables separable, homogeneous (y = vx), aur linear first-order (integrating factor). Constants hata kar differential equations ka formation aur growth/decay applications bhi aate hain.

formulas.name: Order and degree
formulas.formula: order = highest derivative;  degree = power of the highest derivative (equation must be polynomial in derivatives)
formulas.mistake: Agar derivative sin, eˣ, log waghera ke andar ho to degree undefined hai — number mat likhna.

formulas.name: Formation of a DE
formulas.formula: differentiate as many times as there are arbitrary constants and eliminate them
formulas.note: n arbitrary constants wali family se order n ki DE banti hai.

formulas.name: Variables separable
formulas.when: x aur y terms alag karo.

formulas.name: Homogeneous equation
formulas.formula: dy/dx = F(y/x): put y = vx, dy/dx = v + x dv/dx, then separate

formulas.name: Linear first-order
formulas.formula: dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x):  IF = e^{∫P dx};  y·IF = ∫Q·IF dx + C

formulas.name: Linear in x
formulas.formula: dx/dy + P(y)x = Q(y):  IF = e^{∫P dy};  x·IF = ∫Q·IF dy + C
formulas.when: Jab equation x mein linear ho.

formulas.name: Exponential growth/decay
formulas.formula: dN/dt = kN ⇒ N = N₀e^{kt};  half-life = ln 2/|k|

formulas.name: Exact-differential tricks
formulas.formula: x dy + y dx = d(xy);  (x dy − y dx)/x² = d(y/x);  (x dy − y dx)/(x² + y²) = d(tan⁻¹(y/x))

formulas.name: Bernoulli form
formulas.formula: dy/dx + Py = Qyⁿ: divide by yⁿ and put z = y¹⁻ⁿ → linear in z

examples.title: Order aur degree
examples.solution: Sabse oonchi derivative y″ ⇒ order 2; uski power ⇒ degree 3.

examples.title: Separable
examples.solution: dy/y = 2x dx ⇒ ln|y| = x² + c ⇒ y = Ce^{x²}.

examples.title: Linear
examples.solution: IF = eˣ ⇒ y eˣ = ∫e^{−x}eˣ dx = x + C ⇒ y = (x + C)e^{−x}.

examples.title: Growth
examples.problem: Ek population 10 saal mein dugni hoti hai (dN/dt = kN). Teen guna kab hogi?
examples.solution: k = ln 2/10; tripling time = ln 3/k = 10 ln 3/ln 2 ≈ 15.85 saal.

examples.title: Homogeneous
examples.solution: y = vx ⇒ v + x dv/dx = 1 + v ⇒ dv = dx/x ⇒ v = ln|x| + C ⇒ y = x ln|x| + Cx.

topics.title: General vs particular solution
topics.explain: General: order ke barabar arbitrary constants. Particular: di gayi conditions se constants fix. Singular solution (general se na nikalne wala) JEE Main syllabus ke bahar hai.

topics.title: Recognising homogeneous functions
topics.explain: f(x, y) degree n ka homogeneous hai agar f(λx, λy) = λⁿf(x, y). dy/dx = f/g homogeneous hai jab f aur g ki degree same ho.

topics.title: Reducible to homogeneous
topics.explain: dy/dx = (a₁x + b₁y + c₁)/(a₂x + b₂y + c₂): constants hataane ke liye origin shift karo x = X + h, y = Y + k, jab tak a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ na ho (tab a₁x + b₁y = t rakho).

topics.title: Geometric applications
topics.explain: Tangent ka slope = dy/dx; subtangent, subnormal aur orthogonal trajectories (dy/dx ki jagah −dx/dy) se DEs banti hain.

topics.title: Checking solutions
topics.explain: Solution ko DE mein waapas rakho — MCQs mein options verify karne ka sabse tez tareeka.

topics.title: Standard families
topics.explain: Origin se guzarne wale aur x-axis par centre wale circles, x-axis ke saath axis wale parabolas, straight lines y = mx + c (DE y″ = 0) — inki DEs banana practise karo.

ratta: Order = highest derivative;  degree = its power.
IF = e^{∫P dx};  y·IF = ∫Q·IF dx + C.
d(xy) = x dy + y dx;  d(y/x) = (x dy − y dx)/x².
